detailed_descriptions_html.en:
THE TREASURE ROOM IS A MESS. SOMEONE HAS TO SORT IT OUT!


⛏️ Organize the Dwarfs Hoard

It has been a particularly lucrative year in the Dwarf mines. So much so, that the loot has completely swallowed up the treasure room and everything inside it. As B.E.A.R.D's (Bureau of Earnings, Assets, Revenue & Debts) newest intern it is your job to SORT. IT. OUT.

💰 Sweep up the Stash

Gather up armfuls of gold at a time and deposit them into the racks around the hall; when one fills up, you'll earn a skill point to unlock powerful runes that will assist you in this mammoth task.

📜Find what the gold buried

As you dig through the mountain of gold you will uncover relics of bygone eras and secrets buried beneath. The more you sort, the more you will discover.
